query:
When Nadia proposed a dedicated full-group critique session, what did the group decide -- and who objected to the original format?

Options:
A. Nadia
B. Reuben
C. Simone
D. Yuki
context:
[1] (about=Callum, episodic, t2 @2026-02-15T10:46:00) I am in favour. Having something structured to work toward helps, assuming we get enough pieces ready in time. I would rather have a proper critique than an improvised one.
[2] (about=Nadia, episodic, t2 @2026-02-15T10:42:00) okay so here's the thing, I've been thinking about doing a group critique session properly in March -- not just a quick chat but a proper round of feedback. I'm wondering if we should do it as the main activity rather than alongside throwing. thoughts? I can set it up properly -- printed notes, the whole thing. 📋
[3] (about=Reuben, core, t14 @2026-08-23T09:57:00) Prefers critique sessions only when pieces are genuinely done; otherwise keep as working time.
[4] (about=Simone, core, t2 @2026-02-15T09:51:00) Wants feedback on bowls; eager for critique.
[5] (about=Yuki, episodic, t14 @2026-08-23T10:23:00) I had been making ceramics for two years on my own before this group. I was going to stop. I thought I had reached a point where I could not see how to go further without someone to work alongside. I signed up for a different collective first and left after one session -- too social, too much talking about the work instead of doing it. I nearly quit ceramics entirely before I found this one.
[6] (about=GROUP, said_by=Nadia, group-interaction, t2 @2026-02-15T09:51:00) Group agreed to have a proper critique session in March as last 40 minutes of a session; Nadia to plan with printed notes.
[7] (about=GROUP, said_by=Nadia, group-interaction, t13 @2026-08-23T09:54:00) September booking sorted; one session per month September through December; proper group critique session in October.
[8] (about=GROUP, said_by=Nadia, group-interaction, t4 @2026-03-15T09:59:00) Group agreed to next session on April 12th, same studio, 10am-1pm.
[9] (about=GROUP, said_by=Nadia, group-interaction, t8 @2026-05-17T09:38:00) Nadia booked studio for full three hours and arranged use of back room after for tea and goodbye for Callum's last session.
[10] (about=GROUP, said_by=Nadia, group-interaction, t12 @2026-07-19T09:49:00) Nadia proposes last forty minutes as quick round of feedback; same format as session two; optional; put piece on table for eyes. Reuben and Simone agree; Yuki will put tall bottle in.
[11] (about=GROUP, said_by=Nadia, group-interaction, t2 @2026-02-15T09:51:00) Group agreed to March 15 session date.
agent_answer:
The group decided to hold a proper critique session in March as the **last 40 minutes** of a session, with Nadia to plan it using printed notes.

The person who objected to the original format was **Reuben (B)** — he preferred critique sessions only when pieces were genuinely done, otherwise keeping the time as working time.
